title: Playtest report (.gamestudio/playtests/*.playtest.json, evidence playthrough.json)
description: Result of a playtest: a deterministic scripted playthrough, bot runs, a persona playtest by the player-simulator agent, or a human session. Engine runners (Godot runner.gd, Unity PlaytestRunner) write this shape; the playthrough gate accepts it as evidence. A "pass" verdict cannot coexist with blocker findings or crashes.

allOf.description: A passing report must have zero crashes and no blocker findings.

feature_id.description: Feature under test, when the report is gate evidence.

build.description: Build identifier: version, commit hash or CI run, e.g. "0.3.0+a1b2c3d".

mode.description: deterministic_script (scripted inputs with state assertions), bot (automated policy over many runs), persona (player-simulator agent role-playing a persona), human (real players).

persona.description: Persona used in persona mode (id or description).

runs.description: Number of runs aggregated in metrics (1 for a scripted playthrough).

seed.description: RNG seed of the first run; scripted playthroughs must be reproducible with it.

steps.description: Step log of a scripted or persona playthrough.

items.description: One step: an action, what was expected, what was observed.

t.description: Time since start in seconds (or simulation tick / step index for headless runs; say which in notes).

observed.description: Observed values for the expected keys (any JSON).

win_rate.description: Share of runs won, or null when not applicable.

avg_session_sec.description: Average run / session length in seconds.

time_to_first_reward_sec.description: Seconds from start to the first reward; the FTUE proxy for time to fun.

softlocks.description: Runs that reached a state with no legal progress.

crashes.description: Crashes or fatal errors; must be 0 for a pass.

errors.description: Non-fatal errors logged (script errors, failed assertions outside steps).

screenshots.description: Screenshots captured during the run (project-relative paths).

severity.description: blocker (cannot ship / gate fails), major (hurts the experience for many players), minor (noticeable, workaround exists), polish (nice to fix).

detail.description: What happened, expected versus actual, player impact.

repro.description: Reproduction steps (or the seed and step index).

verdict.description: Overall result against the test's targets.
